name: Lachief

sources.title: Submit A Tool - Lachief.io Tally submission form

requirements: Only useful AI or software tools are accepted; other submissions are rejected
Newsletters and other tool directories are explicitly rejected
Submissions with affiliate URLs or bit.ly links are rejected
Maximum of 1 listing per submitted tool
Every tool is reviewed manually before going live
preparation: Submitter name, last name, company, and email
Tool name, tagline, and full description
Canonical tool URL (no affiliate or shortened links)
Up to 3 categories and up to 6 topics to select
Square tool logo 540x540 with background color, JPG or PNG, max 2MB
Optional: affiliate program application link, promo code, message
workflow: Open the Tally submission form at https://tally.so/r/w4Jb4b (linked from the 'Submit Tool' nav item on lachief.io)
Fill in submitter details (name, last name, company, email)
Fill in tool name, tagline, and description
Pick up to 3 categories and up to 6 topics
In the 'Listing details' checkboxes, select 'Listing only (Free)' — or 'Update Listing (Free)' if the tool is already listed
Submit the form and wait for manual review; approved free listings can take up to 7 days to go live
watchFor: Checkbox field defaults toward paid options: 'Featured listing (7-days $250)' and 'Video promo + Featured listing' are upsells — select the free checkbox deliberately
To promote an already-listed tool a separate Tally form (https://tally.so/r/nraXLl) must be used instead
For updates to an existing listing, choose 'Update Listing' rather than submitting a new listing (duplicates are rejected)
Affiliate or bit.ly URLs in the tool URL field cause rejection
Featured placement only lasts 7 days even when paid
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a public page under lachief.io/tool-posts/<slug> and/or surfaces in Browse Tools / category pages and the 'New AI Tools' section
unknowns: Whether rejection is communicated by email or silent
Exact review criteria beyond the published acceptance rules
Whether the free listing link is dofollow (catalog note says follow, not confirmed on site)
